rules..drawer-pane-content: -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; gap: 0; min-width: 0; overflow-y: scroll; overscroll-behavior: contain; padding: 0.75rem 0.8rem 1rem; touch-action: pan-y
rules..navigation-drawer.search-fullscreen .dr:
border-right: none; overflow: hidden; padding: 0; transition: width 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
              padding 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); width: 0

rules..index-sort-tabs: border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10); display: flex; flex-shrink: 0; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.35rem; padding-bottom: 0.45rem
